run_benchmark_rgb_rgbd_depth: run a benchmark on the habitat simulator measuring FPS for rgb, rgbd, and depth_only sensor modes
run_benchmark_semantic_sensor: run a benchmark on the habitat simulator with semantic sensor enabled using the --benchmark_semantic_sensor flag
run_benchmark_physics: run a benchmark on the habitat simulator with physics enabled and configurable number of spawned objects
run_benchmark_multi_resolution: run a benchmark on the habitat simulator across multiple resolutions and concurrent process counts
run_benchmark_custom_scene: run a benchmark on the habitat simulator with a custom scene, seed, and max frames
